北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，湿度高体感闷热，出行注意安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has fog, high humidity makes it feel stuffy. Stay safe!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天体感炎热，记得多喝水、防暑降温哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and feels hot. Remember to hydrate and cool down!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云体感闷热无风，注意防暑，保持清爽心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is partly cloudy and feels hot with no wind. Stay cool and happy!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州大雨伴有大风，出行请带雨具，注意安全哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has heavy rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella and stay safe!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天湿度大，感觉黏黏的？注意除湿，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast with high humidity. Feeling sticky? Dehumidify and keep a good mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天有点热，外出记得防晒，保持舒适哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and a bit hot. Remember sun protection and stay comfortable!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云体感炎热，外出注意防暑，多补充水分哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is partly cloudy and feels hot. Stay cool and hydrate well!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度适中体感舒适，记得保持好心情！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with comfortable humidity. Keep a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云酷热，体感温度高，务必注意防暑降温！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is partly cloudy and scorching hot. Be sure to prevent heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天湿度大，体感略闷，穿衣注意舒适透气哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast with high humidity. Wear comfortable, breathable clothes!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿度大，出门带好雨具，保持好心情哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and keep a good mood!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，湿度非常大，注意除湿，小心着凉哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy with very high humidity. Dehumidify and watch out for chills!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天体感闷热，湿度 100% 像蒸桑拿，注意防潮！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels stuffy, 100% humidity feels like a sauna. Watch out for dampness!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明中雨气温凉爽，湿度高注意保暖，带好雨具！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has moderate rain and cool temps. High humidity, stay warm and bring an umbrella!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天湿度大，体感微热，注意补充水分哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with high humidity, feeling slightly warm. Remember to hydrate!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，湿度高体感闷热，出行注意交通安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has fog, high humidity makes it feel stuffy. Watch out for traffic!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗但体感闷热，湿度大，记得防晒多喝水哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels stuffy with high humidity. Remember sun protection and hydrate!
